paite: Asa kum sawmthum-le-guk avaihawm kum in Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judahte asual a, Judah kumpipa kiang a lut ding leh pawt ding dalna ding in Ramah khua abawl hi.
heading: Israel Toh Buainate / (1 Kum 15.17-22)
english: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

paite: Huchi in Asa in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou dangkasik leh dangka-engte alakhia a, Damaskas a Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad kiang ah,
english: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of Yahweh’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

paite: "Ka pa leh na pa kal a thukhun a-om bang mah in i kikal ah thukhun a-om a, ngai dih, dangkasik leh dangka-engte ka hon khak ahi; kisa dih, Israel kumpipa Baasha in ahon tawpsanna ding in akiang ah na thukhun phel nawn mai in," chi in akhak hi.
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

paite: Huchi in Ben-hadad in kumpipa Asa thu ana pom a; Israel khuate sual ding in sepaih heutute asawl a, Ijon khua, Dan khua, Abel-maim khua, Naphtali gam a vankoihna khua tengteng asual uhi.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Baasha in huai thu azak in Ramah khua abawl lai akhawlsan a, athilhih tup akikhelsakta hi.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Asa in Judah mi tengteng api a. Baasha in Ramah khua bawlna ding a suang leh sing azatte ala vek ua, huaite in Geba leh Mizpah khua abawl hi.
english: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.

paite: Huai lai in zawlnei Hanani Judah kumpipa Asa kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian muang lou in Siria kumpipa na muang a, huaiziak in Siria kumpipa sepaihhonte na khahta ahi.
heading: Zawlnei Hanani
english: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on Yahweh your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

paite: Ethiopiate leh Libiate sepaihhon liantak, kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite tampi ahi kei uh maw? Himahleh TOUPA na muan ziak in na khut ah ahon pia hi.
english: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on Yahweh, he delivered them into your hand.

paite: Amah lam a lungsim diktak pu mite tung a ahatdan hihlang ding in leitung tengteng ah TOUPA mit avak dundun hi. Haihuai mahmah in thil na hihta a; tuban dou na nei gige ding," achi hi.
english: For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”

paite: Huchi in zawlnei tung ah Asa aheh a, suangkul ah akhumta a; athugen ziak in aheh mahmah mai hi. Asa in mi khenkhatte leng asimmoh behlap lai hi.
english: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.

paite: Huan ngai dih ua, Asa tanchin abul a kipan a atawp pha in Judah leh Israel kumpipate tanchin gelhna bu ah gelh in a-om hi.
heading: Asa Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (1 Kum 15.23,24)
english: Behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

paite: Kum sawmthum-le-kua vai ahawm kum in Asa khe ahong na a; anatna thupitak ahi; himahleh anatna ah TOUPA zong lou in damdawi siamte azong zaw hi.
english: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa was diseased in his feet. His disease was exceedingly great; yet in his disease he didn’t seek Yahweh, but just the physicians.

paite: Huchi in api-le-pute kiang ah Asa a-ihmu a, kum sawmli-le-khat avaihawm kum in asita hi.
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

paite: David khopi a amah a tuam dia ahankhuk ah avui ua, gimlimtak, gimlim bawl mite'n gimlim chí tuamtuam a dim a kibawl lupna ah asial ua, amah zahtakna in meikuang thupi mahmah asem uhi.
english: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.
